def factor_price_volume_rank_correlation(df):
    """Rolling Spearman rank correlation between close and volume, capturing price-volume coherence."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    window = 20
    close_rank = close.rolling(window, min_periods=window).rank(pct=True)
    volume_rank = volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).rank(pct=True)
    factor = close_rank.rolling(window, min_periods=window).corr(volume_rank)
    df_copy["factor_price_volume_rank_correlation"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_price_volume_rank_correlation"]
description: This factor measures the monotonic coherence between price level and volume level over the trailing 20 days using rolling percentile ranks and their correlation (Spearman). A high positive correlation indicates that higher volume days align with higher prices, a sign of sustained directional demand; negative correlation suggests volume expansion on down days, distribution. Using ranks makes the signal robust to outliers and scale differences, capturing an uncovered raw pathway of price-volume coherence distinct from return-volume correlation or VWAP divergence.
